author: SickProdigy
description: An experimental persistent solo and two-player Magic: The Gathering rules prototype with private hands, curated starter decks, and the complete Alpha catalog and progressive rules support.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, active match state, private hands, decks, public game actions, and channel/message identifiers until the match record is deleted. User deletion removes matches involving that user.
install_msg: Start with `[p]mtg solo red easy` or `[p]mtg challenge @member`. Alpha cards are progressively promoted only after their rules pass engine tests; fixed starter decks remain unchanged.
name: MTG
short: Persistent solo and two-player MTG prototype
